Tomato___Early_blight.about: A fungal disease causing brown spots with rings on older leaves first.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Remove infected leaves. Spray neem oil or a copper-based fungicide. Mulch the soil.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical: Mancozeb or chlorothalonil spray, used exactly as the product label says.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops every 2-3 years, water at the base (not on leaves), keep plants spaced.

Tomato___Late_blight.about: A fast-spreading disease causing dark, water-soaked patches. Worse in cool, wet weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Remove and destroy infected plants. Copper-based spray can slow it.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical: Mancozeb or metalaxyl-based fungicide as per label. Act quickly.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid wet leaves, improve airflow, use resistant varieties, do not compost infected plants.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Keep checking regularly, water at the base, and keep the field clean.
